slots.label: Cubic–line intersections and sign inequalities
slots.labelAf: Snyding van kubiese grafiek en lyn, en tekenongelykhede

items.q: Determine the remainder when p(x) = x³ − 2x² + x − 5 is divided by x − 2.
items.qAf: Bepaal die res wanneer p(x) = x³ − 2x² + x − 5 deur x − 2 gedeel word.
items.explain: By the remainder theorem, the remainder is p(2) = 8 − 8 + 2 − 5 = −3.
items.explainAf: Volgens die reststelling is die res p(2) = 8 − 8 + 2 − 5 = −3.

items.q: Show that (x + 1) is a factor of x³ + 2x² − x − 2 and factorise fully.
items.qAf: Toon dat (x + 1) ’n faktor van x³ + 2x² − x − 2 is en faktoriseer volledig.
items.explain: p(−1) = 0, so (x + 1) is a factor. Dividing gives x² + x − 2 = (x + 2)(x − 1).
items.explainAf: p(−1) = 0, dus is (x + 1) ’n faktor. Deling gee x² + x − 2 = (x + 2)(x − 1).

items.q: Given that x + 2 is a factor of x³ + kx² − 4x + 8, determine k.
items.qAf: Gegee dat x + 2 ’n faktor van x³ + kx² − 4x + 8 is, bepaal k.

items.q: What is the maximum number of real roots of a cubic polynomial?
items.qAf: Wat is die maksimum aantal reële wortels van ’n kubieke polinoom?
items.explain: A cubic has degree 3, so it has at most 3 real roots.
items.explainAf: ’n Kubieke polinoom het graad 3, dus het dit hoogstens 3 reële wortels.

items.q: The graph of y = x³ − 3x has a turning point at x = 1. What is the y-coordinate of this turning point?
items.qAf: Die grafiek van y = x³ − 3x het ’n draaipunt by x = 1. Wat is die y-koördinaat van hierdie draaipunt?

items.q: Which statement about f(x) = −(x − 1)²(x + 2) is true?
items.qAf: Watter stelling oor f(x) = −(x − 1)²(x + 2) is waar?
options: It touches the x-axis at x = 1 and crosses it at x = −2
It crosses the x-axis at x = 1 and touches it at x = −2
It has only one x-intercept at x = −2
optionsAf: It touches the x-axis at x = 1 and crosses it at x = −2
It crosses the x-axis at x = 1 and touches it at x = −2
It has only one x-intercept at x = −2
items.explain: (x − 1)² gives a double root at x = 1 (touching), and (x + 2) gives a single root at x = −2 (crossing). f(0) = −2.
items.explainAf: (x − 1)² gee ’n dubbele wortel by x = 1 (raak), en (x + 2) gee ’n enkel wortel by x = −2 (sny). f(0) = −2.

items.q: If f(x) − g(x) = 0 has a repeated root at x = a, the line g(x) is:
items.qAf: As f(x) − g(x) = 0 ’n herhaalde wortel by x = a het, is die lyn g(x):
options: perpendicular to the cubic at x = a
a tangent to the cubic at x = a
optionsAf: loodreg op die kubiese grafiek by x = a
’n raaklyn aan die kubiese grafiek by x = a
items.explain: A repeated root means the line touches the curve at that point.
items.explainAf: ’n Herhaalde wortel beteken die lyn raak die kurwe by daardie punt.

items.q: f(x) = x³ − 4x² + x + 6 and g(x) = x + 6 meet where x³ − 4x² = 0. The x-coordinate where g cuts (not touches) f is:
items.qAf: f(x) = x³ − 4x² + x + 6 en g(x) = x + 6 ontmoet waar x³ − 4x² = 0. Die x-koördinaat waar g vir f sny (nie raak nie), is:
items.explain: x²(x − 4) = 0: x = 0 is a repeated root (touch); x = 4 is where g cuts f.
items.explainAf: x²(x − 4) = 0: x = 0 is ’n herhaalde wortel (raak); x = 4 is waar g vir f sny.
